question: List the first 5 streams that have been in the same language and game for over 5 years.
cypher:
MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game), (s)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language)
WHERE datetime() - s.createdAt > duration({years: 5})
WITH s, g, l
ORDER BY s.createdAt
LIMIT 5
RETURN s.name AS stream_name, g.name AS game_name, l.name AS language_name, s.createdAt AS stream_created_at
error: Unsupported feature: date arithmetic (datetime() - createdAt > duration) is not supported in TypeQL

question: Which are the first 5 streams that have a language and a game both starting with the same letter?
cypher:
MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language), (s)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game)
WHERE l.name STARTS WITH g.name[0]
RETURN s.name AS stream_name, l.name AS language_name, g.name AS game_name
ORDER BY s.createdAt
LIMIT 5
error: Unsupported: string indexing (g.name[0]) to extract first character. TypeQL has no substring/character extraction functions.

question: Which 3 streams had the most chatters in the past month?
cypher:
MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User)
WHERE s.createdAt >= datetime() - duration('P1M')
WITH s, COUNT(u) AS chatterCount
ORDER BY chatterCount DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN s.name AS streamName, chatterCount
error: Unsupported: date arithmetic (datetime() - duration) has no TypeQL equivalent

question: List the top 3 games played by streams with a description length over 50 characters.
cypher:
MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game)
WHERE size(s.description) > 50
RETURN g.name, count(s) AS stream_count
ORDER BY stream_count DESC
LIMIT 3

question: Which are the first 3 streams that have had a VIP relationship with the same user for over 3 years?
cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[r:VIP]->(s:Stream)
WHERE duration.inSeconds(r.since, datetime()).years > 3
RETURN s.name AS stream_name, r.since AS vip_since
ORDER BY r.since
LIMIT 3
error: Unsupported: date arithmetic (duration.inSeconds().years > 3) and relation attribute r.since does not exist in schema (vip_status has no attributes)

question: List the first 3 streams that have a game and team name starting with the same letter.
cypher:
MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game), (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team)
WHERE toLower(substring(g.name, 0, 1)) = toLower(substring(t.name, 0, 1))
RETURN s.name AS stream_name, g.name AS game_name, t.name AS team_name
ORDER BY s.createdAt
LIMIT 3
error: Unsupported: substring() string function has no TypeQL equivalent. Cannot dynamically compare first characters of two different attributes.

question: List the first 5 streams that have been moderated by the same user for over 5 years.
cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[mod:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream)
WHERE datetime() - mod.since > duration('P5Y')
RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.url AS stream_url, u.name AS moderator_name
ORDER BY mod.since
LIMIT 5
error: Unsupported: date arithmetic (datetime() - mod.since > duration) is not available in TypeQL

question: List the first 5 games with streams that have been active for over 10 years.
cypher:
MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game)
WHERE datetime().epochMillis - s.createdAt.epochMillis > 10 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000
RETURN DISTINCT g.name
LIMIT 5
error: Unsupported: date arithmetic (datetime().epochMillis subtraction to compute duration)

question: Show the 3 streams that have the longest descriptions.
cypher:
MATCH (s:Stream)
RETURN s.name, s.description
ORDER BY size(s.description) DESC
LIMIT 3
error: Cypher uses size() for string length which is unsupported in TypeQL

question: Which streams have the longest moderator chains (a moderator, who is also a moderator, and so on)?
cypher:
MATCH path = (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR*]->(u:User)
WITH s, length(path) AS chainLength
ORDER BY chainLength DESC
LIMIT 1
RETURN s.name AS streamName, chainLength
error: Unsupported: variable-length path traversal ([:MODERATOR*]) and length(path) for measuring chain depth. TypeQL has no recursive/transitive path support.

question: Which 3 streams have the most complex descriptions based on word count?
cypher:
MATCH (s:Stream)
WITH s, size(split(s.description, " ")) AS wordCount
ORDER BY wordCount DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN s.name AS streamName, s.description AS description, wordCount
error: Unsupported: split() and size() string functions have no TypeQL equivalent. Cannot compute word count from description.

question: Which streams were created in 2019 and have a description longer than 50 characters?
cypher:
MATCH (s:Stream)
WHERE s.createdAt >= datetime('2019-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND s.createdAt < datetime('2020-01-01T00:00:00Z')
  AND size(s.description) > 50
RETURN s.id, s.name, s.description, s.createdAt
